answer: An attacker running 182 aliases thus needs 94 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are written down in ivory, expire in falcon, and karst lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 29 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3588 identities would post 3824 proofs and burn roughly 79 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
